svg.title: Charge, dry and degas the cadmium/ligand mixture · conceptual
svg.desc: Charge 0.1 mmol cadmium stearate, 0.1 g HH, 1 g HDA and 5 g OD. Dry and degas in the reaction flask at 200 °C for 30 min under a stream of argon. Conceptual action diagram. The source says reaction flask; its shape, neck count, volume, fill and heating apparatus are not specified. Arrows indicate an action only. No missing reactor value, phase handling or rate is inferred from this drawing.
